notes.title: 22/02/2025 - More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello again~

[list]
[*]Fixed a visual issue where [b]Kazuya[/b] would glow indefinitely instead of glowing periodically when he has the [b]Void Curse[/b] status effect.
[*]Fixed an issue where the "[b]IT'S TIME FOR A CHANGE[/b]" achievement was not unlocking reliably.
[*]Fixed an issue where the "[b]JUMP QUEEN[/b]" achievement sometimes required restarting the game to unlock.
[/list]

Sorry for the inconvenience!
